The `merge-a` proposal is clear, so I made no rewrite. `node Server/text-check.mjs` on the task folder printed `[]`, with no flags.

I read it as an agent brief, not an owner-facing page. It opens with a one-line "why", the build is numbered, the proofs and fences are explicit, and each file path is given in full. I did not shoot any pages, because the folder has no `page.js`.

I logged one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
